what: 'Talleyrand, how do we make peace with Austria' — the counsel with PC-F1's note
action: type Talleyrand, how do we make peace with Austria
lines:
TALLEYRAND'S ASSESSMENT — Austria

"Sire, we hold the upper hand against Austria. War score: 79. I recommend pressing for peace on favorable terms. In the field we outmatch them decisively. They cannot sustain this war indefinitely.

Alternatively, continue fighting to improve terms further — though I caution against overreach. Empires are lost to greed as often as to defeat.

Mark one thing, Sire: Bavaria is still at war with Austria, and a separate peace would break her war. Two ways out — propose an armistice, or first Downgrade the alliance with Bavaria (2 steps) below a defensive alliance."

what: Austria's armistice letter — what shows without scrolling
lines:
DIPLOMATIC ENVOY
Metternich (Schemer) of Austria

Proposes: Armistice
Terms:
France demands:
  - Austria pays 168 gold per turn to France for as long as the treaty stands
Mutual:
  - Armistice (cease hostilities temporarily) — France and Austria

Assessment: GENEROUS

War Summary
War score: 52 ^ (Territory +10, Battle +15, Decisive Battle +10, Ticking -4)
Settlement: Dictated Terms
Objective: Defense - the homeland — 28 of 28 provinces held (inactive)
Ticking: +0
Duration: 6 turns   Battles: 8W / 3L
Casualties: ours 29789 / theirs 78587
We hold: Bohemia, Tyrol

Armistice Terms
  A 5-turn ceasefire: fighting stops, and the battles fought so far are struck from the war score — if the war resumes, it resumes from nothing. The campaign ledger of provinces and dead still stands. No territory or gold changes hands at its end.
  When it expires: peace if relations have healed to -60 or better — otherwise the war resumes.
  Relations stand at -80 and will thaw to -65 by expiry — short of -60; the war resumes when the truce expires unless relations improve by other means, or a second truce follows.

Political Consequences
  - Bavaria stays at war with Austria under this truce — an ally, not a client: her war runs on, and 3 French corps stand on Bavarian soil under the truce.
  - Our clients follow us out of the truce: Kingdom of Italy.
  - Austria sits outside your bloc. Peace normalizes relations with a nation resisting your European influence.

Metternich, with perfect politeness: "Vienna observes, with some weariness, that the fighting no longer serves even its winners. Grant the armistice. We will not pretend Marshal Ney's laurels at Bohemia count for nothing in this."

An interesting proposal. I shall study the terms closely.

This offer will lapse at end of turn.

controls.tooltip: He sends a counter of his own choosing; if he finds none, nothing is spent and the offer stands
